verified_rules: positive boxes are taken from Google Vision localized object annotations whose names pass _is_fish_term and whose scores are >= recognition_pipeline_v1.json strong_confidence (0.35).
effective_status is taken from FishPresenceResult.status; app/presence.py stores a valid human_override in row.status, while its box geometry still comes from evidence.objects.
if effective_status == no_fish, the builder emits a negative candidate with an empty box list without checking the collected high-score fish boxes.
if effective_status is single_fish or multi_fish but no object box passes the fish-name, 0.35 score and geometry filters, no positive candidate is emitted.
split assignment hashes batch_id:image_id per image; there is no source_group_id based grouped split in this builder.

bootstrap_manifest rows contain asset IDs, batch/image IDs, GCS URI, split, presence status, negative flag, boxes and dimensions; they do not contain source SHA, reviewer, license/permission, hard-scene tags or manual bbox provenance.
